sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowance and Privileges Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2004
ACT I OF 2004
BALOCHISTAN CHIEF
MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act, further to
amend the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th February, 2003]
No. PAB/Legis: V(12)/2004,
dated 20-2-2004.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2004 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 19th January, 2004 and assented to
by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.--- (1) This Bill may be called the Balochistan Chief Minister
and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges (Amendment) Act,
2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of January,
2003.
